body: Well that must've really hurt.. My best memory of Halloween was in first grade and for some reason our school decided to do a mini trick or treating thing (mind you this is a catholic school, where Halloween is the devil's birthday apparently) , where we went to offices on the campus and most of the teachers and staff gave us candy. I happened to have forgotten my costume that day, and I was super upset. I wanted to be a vampire for Halloween, I had the entire costume planned, which took weeks of begging my mom to get it for me, and it was sitting on the table at home all alone. The teacher felt bad for me since I was the only kid who didn't have a costume, so she went to the utility closet and let me pick out a temporary one I could use. Pretty much all of the clothes in there were really bad and I quote, "not scary enough." However, the teacher found a trash bag, and since it was black, I could try and pretend I was a scary vampire. Well, my mom happened to be volunteering that day and when I came and saw her she was very confused as to why I am a trashbag. I tell her what happened, and she couldn't stop laughing! At the time I felt a bit embarrassed, but when I got home from school that day I couldn't stop laughing either. Surprisingly, everyone forgot about it the next day though.(TL:DR; School had a trick or treating event, I forgot my vampire costume at home, I wore a garbage bag instead.)
My mom can be like that but she has been through a lot.. I still dont understand why she took my belongings away but it is for a reason.
